summary: Mother and four children (ages 6, 7, 11 and 12) got lost in a Monday downpour on Blodgett Peak; the family had climbed ~3/4 of the way up the peak and made a 'mad dash for cover' when the rain hit, losing the trail; ~6-hour rescue by four Colorado Springs firefighters and two El Paso County Search and Rescue teams; found near a chimney-shaped rock via cell-phone contact, secured with ropes and descended wet rocky terrain; soaked but unscathed
location: Blodgett Peak (off Woodmen Road), Colorado Springs area
responding_agency: Colorado Springs Fire Department; El Paso County Search and Rescue
notes: Firehouse syndication of The Gazette (Colorado Springs) 2014-06-24 story (copyright 2014); date weekday-verified Monday; peak in Waldo Canyon fire burn area; first El Paso 2014 row beyond the Garden of the Gods fall; distinct incident from id 203 (same day, different peak)
